bibl.title: The Decline of Ptolemaic Elephant Hunting: Analysis of the Contributory Factors.
bibl.seg: Matthew Cobb, The Decline of Ptolemaic Elephant Hunting: Analysis of the Contributory Factors.
bibl.note: Ptolemaic elephant hunting: a brief survey. - The decline of elephant hunting: causal factors: Battle of Raphia (217) and rivalry with the Seleucids; - The Great Revolt of the Egyptians (205-186 BC); - Exhaustion of elephant-hunting grounds; - Breeding elephants in Egypt. - Conclusion.
